massingBasis: All four records keep the exact City of Austin 2023 footprint ring and the frozen context.json massing (one flat volume): campus Y = LiDAR groundY datum + USGS 3DEP TX_Central_B1_2017 P95. The 2017 massing is the baseline geometry, NOT a claim that the 2026 buildings match it 1:1. No massing entry is edited.
photoPolicy: Reference photographs were collected by the coordinator into .work/retail-references (sha256 + page URLs in .work/retail-references/sources.json). They are research inputs only: no image is shipped or loaded at runtime; colours are hand-read rendered averages and all dimensions not stated below are estimates from pixel proportions.
